end.summary:
Pihu named small soil and leaf-litter animals, including earthworm, ant, and millipede.
Pihu said earthworm tunnels provide space for plants, but did not explain the full soil-help process.
Pihu repeatedly said earthworms spoil soil, harm roots, or should be removed.
The earthworm misconception was not corrected by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming animals found in soil and discussing how earthworms and other soil animals help. Pihu used clues such as an earthworm’s body shape and lack of legs, but mixed up earthworm castings with harmful waste; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, you can look at a small patch of soil or leaf litter together and discuss how tunnels let in air and water and how dead leaves become rich soil.
